_note: Heals, shields and helmets, Season 30 (docs/RESEARCH_PHASE_11.md sections 1 to 3). Amounts in shield or health points (999: all of it), use times in seconds, stacks per inventory slot. While healing you move 40% slower and cannot sprint; sprinting, firing, aiming or a swap cancels; the item is spent when it finishes.
_phoenixName: the phoenix kit's name (blank above) is in src/config/names.ts: the game's own while the project is private, a codename (Nova kit) on a public build
_kits: what you start a life with: the arena and the bot match get a fixed kit (ours: two of the big heals, four of the small); a battle royale starts empty and loots (the start kit is for when loot is off)
_shields: Shield cores (Season 20 on): you start at white 50; EVO (squad.json's sources: the damage you deal, knocks, assists, revives, care packages) takes it to blue 75 at 450 and purple 100 at 1,700 more, 2,150 in all (docs/RESEARCH_PHASE_12.md section 2.3; Phase 11 had 1,700 in all). Red 125 only from the mythic helmet. A level-up refilling the shield is ours (unverified for Season 30).
_helmets: Helmets cut no headshot damage since Season 24. The gold one sets your armour to 100 and doubles what cells and syringes heal (we double the amount; the source does not say amount or speed); the mythic (red) one sets it to 125.
_knockdown: Knockdown shields. Season 28 took them out of the loot pool and tied the size to your EVO level, 200 / 450 / 750 (docs/RESEARCH_PHASE_12.md section 2.2, from wiki/Knockdown_Shield and the Breach notes of 2026-02-09). src/config/squad.json holds those same three for the down code, along with the arc and the crawl, and the tiers here are them under their colours so the two cannot drift. Your EVO level is the floor and a shield you find can only raise it. Gold is Apex's old level 4 Guardian Angel shield, removed from every mode on 2024-11-26, and it is back here because the whole point of a tier is that it is a decision: it soaks purple's 750 and no more, and what it adds is one self-revive. Ours, because Apex has published none of it: a self-revive existing at all in Season 30, its channel, and a spent gold shield still soaking 750.
_selfRevive: The gold shield's self-revive, all ours: Apex published no channel for it. Seven seconds is the longest hold in the game on purpose (a squad mate's revive is 5 and a Deathbox Respawn is 7, src/config/squad.json), so pushing a gold knock is still the right call as long as you actually push it. It gives back the 20 health a squad mate's revive gives, for the same reason: getting yourself up should not beat being picked up. Letting go, moving or taking a hit drops the channel and the seconds are not kept, so an interrupted self-revive starts again from nothing, which is what makes shooting a crawling enemy worth the bullets.
_backpacks: Backpacks. The white one has been in the starter kit since Season 28 (docs/RESEARCH_PHASE_12.md section 2.5, Breach), so nobody is ever without one and the three worth finding are blue, purple and gold. Published: with a gold backpack a med kit and a shield battery stack 3 and a phoenix kit stacks 2 (docs/RESEARCH_PHASE_11.md section 1, wiki/Med_Kit, wiki/Shield_Battery, wiki/Phoenix_Kit), which is what purple and gold both give here, because in Apex the level 3 and level 4 packs carry the same six extra slots and gold's difference is its perk rather than its room. Ours, unpublished: how much cell and syringe room each tier adds, and gold's heal time. The stack numbers below are ROOM ON TOP of the heal's own stack above, so the published stacks stay the one place those are written down. Season 30 took gold backpacks out of the loot pool (Marked); ours stays in, because a battle royale whose only other legendary carry item is a helmet has too little reason to read a death box.
_healTime: healTime is the fraction of a heal's published seconds the tier takes, and gold's 0.75 is ours. It is deliberately not a half: TRIAGE already halves every heal (src/game/abilities.ts) and the two multiply, so a gold pack under TRIAGE is a 3 s med kit as it stands.
